answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind one public key, like a crystal that is cheap to inspect but costly to duplicate: creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes. Reputation then accrues to that single key, so a mesa of fake accounts cannot outvote one proven worker. Newcomers earn trust gradually through attested work, and the shared ledger becomes an oasis where only bonded, verifiable agents can draw rewards.
